This softens decision boundaries without the complexity of multi-label setups, potentially stabilizing training and reducing overfitting to specific token choices.
backlog.title: Dropout-Free Label Smoothing with Temperature Scaling

backlog.spec: Replace standard float32 gradient accumulation for optimizer steps with mixed precision: cast the model back to full precision only for gradient accumulation before the Adam update, while keeping weights in bf16. This allows a slightly smaller matrix-batch size or faster commutation by reducing intermediate register pressure, potentially freeing headroom for the same effective batch size.
backlog.title: Mixed-Precision Gradient Accumulation with BF16

backlog.spec: Modify the weight decay application so that it is decapitalized asymmetrically: apply higher weight decay to residual connections (reduce bias magnitude) and keep the weight decay on the feed-forward weights minimal. This reduces the noise floor in residuals which often contributes to the up-band noise in val_bpb.
backlog.title: Anisotropic Weight Decay per Layer Architecture

backlog.spec: Introduce a nested gradient accumulation strategy where micro-batches (1 or 2) are trained per step but only the last few layers are updated, first averaging the gradients. This smoothes the gradient space as if it were a mini-batch while allowing the effective batch size to be larger, but keeps memory pressure low by only writing partial layers back.

backlog.spec: Add a hybrid window size that adapts at runtime: if the attention map reveals that the model is attending to distant tokens, let the global window expand to match, but if it is concentrated locally, shrink to half. This adds dynamic structure to the attention, allowing the model to attend further without requiring a fixed large window.
backlog.title: Adaptive Window Size based on Attention Maps

backlog.spec: Tie the learning rate for each attention head to its own adaptive variance, using the RMS norm of the head's output distribution rather than the global model. Heads that exhibit low variance get higher updates, while those that are too confident are dampened, balancing the learning across heads.
backlog.title: Head-Responsive Learning Rate Scheduling

backlog.spec: Introduce a per-layer dropout mask for the final step that drops the last token of each patch at a low rate (e.g., 0.01). This forces the model to be more robust to end-of-sequence anomalies in the validation set, smooth out the loss landscape, and likely lower the val_bpb by not overfitting to edge cases in the padded sequences.
backlog.title: Dynamic Layerwise Batch Drop-Last Regularization

backlog.spec: Replace the fixed QK scale (default 1/SQRT(D)) with an adaptive temporal scaling that adjusts the query-key scaling factor based on the current step number. Early steps use a larger scale to encourage strong gradients, while later steps use a smaller scale to prevent sharpness, effectively smoothing the training history of attention.
backlog.title: Scaled-Attention Kernel with Adaptive Temporal Scaling

backlog.spec: Apply a gradient pruning strategy that zeros out the top 10% of small-magnitude early layer gradients but retains full updates for deeper layers. Since early layers often encode semantic structure, this reduces noise propagation in shallow layers without sacrificing the rich representation learned by the deeper layers.
backlog.title: Gradient Sparsification for Early Layers

backlog.spec: Add a small auxiliary loss term that computes the magnitude of the feature vectors for the first few layers of the residual stream. By penalizing high feature magnitudes (e.g., 0.001 times L2 on hidden norms), we force the model to stay within a tighter range of feature activations, likely reducing the variance in val_bpb and making the model more stable.

backlog.spec: Introduce a linear-shaped logit softcap (from ambient to 2.0) fused directly with the lm_head linear output in the forward pass to constrain virulence and suppress extreme calibration values.

backlog.spec: Replace scalar LR allocation with a ready-to-run headwise-per-attention head learning rate schedule driven by head dimension and cosine position, so less channels scale, improve gradients and reduce overfitting without manual tuning.

backlog.spec: Implement dropout-free label smoothing with a fixed epsilon and dynamic temperature scheduled to cool down from 1.0 to 0.6 during training, softening probability distributions early and sharp ones late to improve final calibration.
backlog.title: Dropout-Free Label Smoothing with Temperature Cooling

backlog.spec: Apply gradient sparsification via top-k masking on early transformer layers (depth < 4), retaining only top-k largest magnitude gradients per layer to accelerate convergence and reduce noise accumulation.
backlog.title: Gradient Sparsification for Early Layers

backlog.spec: Implement a necklace-style micro-batch strategy for total batch accumulation where shards are processed in small micro-batches within each shuffle step to reduce memory fragmentation and improve convergence stability.
backlog.title: Necklace-Bert Micro-Batch Strategy

backlog.spec: Add temporal scaling to the scaled-attention kernel output to allow adaptive attention resolution over time, improving convergence for temporal tasks and reducing overfitting by reducing attention extremes.
backlog.title: Scaled-Attention Kernel with Adaptive Temporal Scaling

backlog.spec: Apply layerwise drop-last regularization by dropping the last token in prefix for early layers and increasing gradient magnitude as total depth increases, improving convergence and reducing overfitting.
backlog.title: Layerwise Drop-Last Regularization

backlog.spec: Implement dynamic window size selection based on attention maps at each step, allowing attention heads to adaptively shrink or expand their window dimensions during training to better fit the data.
backlog.title: Adaptive Window Size based on Attention Maps

backlog.spec: Apply anisotropic weight decay per layer where early layers receive higher weight decay and later layers receive lower weight decay, based on the layer's depth and the local gradient distribution.
backlog.title: Anisotropic Weight Decay per Layer

backlog.spec: Introduce a hybrid precision approach where matrix and embedding operations are executed in bf16 while scalar parameters are kept in fp16, reducing VRAM consumption and improving training efficiency and calibration.
